notes:
Notes on "Who's the GOAT in football?" (today is Mon, Oct 12, 2026)

**Missing from the question:** "football" could mean soccer or American football. The question doesn't say which. The GOAT label is also an opinion, so no source gives one settled answer.

**If soccer:**
- The debate is still mainly Lionel Messi against Cristiano Ronaldo.
- A Korea Times piece from July 13, 2026 says momentum in the GOAT debate shifted decisively toward Messi after Argentina's Qatar triumph, and the 2026 World Cup widened that gap.
- The same piece says Messi extended his World Cup tally to a record 21 goals against Egypt in the round of 16. It also says Ronaldo became the first player to score in six different World Cups.
- The Korea Times and the other sources are dated before the end of the 2026 World Cup. The results don't say how either player's tournament ended.
- A comparison from thesportsencounter.com (June 25, 2026) says Messi has a record eight Ballon d'Or awards to Ronaldo's five, and one World Cup title to Ronaldo's none.
- The same comparison credits Ronaldo with the all-time Champions League goals and appearance records, and says he holds the men's international goals record.
- That article concludes the balance has shifted further toward Messi in 2026.
- Jamie Carragher has said there was "never a debate" between the two.
- Ronaldo has downplayed Messi's World Cup win, saying "These countries are used to winning big competitions."
- Career totals differ by source. The Korea Times gives Ronaldo 824 club goals and Messi 800. A messivsronaldo.app article gives Messi 903 career goals and Ronaldo 967.
- Pelé and Diego Maradona are mentioned only as earlier-era greats. The results don't rank them against Messi or Ronaldo.

**If American football (NFL):**
- Tom Brady is the most common pick. CBS Sports says no player in the 101-year history of the NFL has as many championships as Brady, who holds the record with seven. It also says he has five Super Bowl MVPs, the most in NFL history.
- A CBS Sports analyst ranked Brady first in a top-25 list of NFL players, per a musketfire.com article from about mid-2025.
- Not everyone agrees. In a February 2026 report, Brady himself said "Jerry Rice is still the GOAT."
- A July 14, 2026 report says former NFL quarterback Chris Simms placed Brady ninth in an all-time quarterbacks poll.
- Jim Brown and Jerry Rice come up as other names in the discussion.
